findings.title: No EMC filtering near P2
findings.description: Connector P2 (SWD) has no ferrite bead, CM choke, or ESD protection within 25mm. Unfiltered I/O cables are the dominant source of radiated emissions — common-mode current as low as 5 µA can exceed FCC Class B.
findings.recommendation: Add a ferrite bead (e.g., BLM18AG601SN1D, 600Ω@100MHz) on signal lines near P2. Add ESD/TVS protection for external interfaces.
findings.summary: No EMC filtering near P2

findings.title: Board cavity resonance frequencies
findings.description: Board (63×83mm, εr=4.4) cavity resonances: (0,1) at 860 MHz; (1,0) at 1127 MHz; (1,1) at 1418 MHz; (0,2) at 1720 MHz; (1,2) at 2057 MHz. PDN impedance spikes at these frequencies. Ensure adequate decoupling at and around these frequencies.
findings.recommendation: Add decoupling capacitors with SRF near these frequencies.
findings.summary: Board cavity resonance frequencies

findings.title: ESD device RV1 far from connector P1
findings.description: RV1 (varistor) is 19.4mm from P1. Estimated pre-TVS trace inductance: ~14nH → ~509V overshoot during 8kV ESD strike (dI/dt = 37.5 GA/s). Recommended: <10mm.
findings.recommendation: Move RV1 closer to P1. The ESD current path from connector to TVS should be as short as possible.
findings.summary: ESD device RV1 far from connector P1

findings.title: No ground via near ESD device RV1
findings.description: RV1 (varistor) has no ground stitching via within 3mm. The TVS ground pad inductance is the most critical parasitic in ESD protection — each nH adds ~37.5V overshoot during an 8kV strike.
findings.recommendation: Add multiple ground vias directly adjacent to RV1 ground pad. Use fat, short traces to ground plane.
findings.summary: No ground via near ESD device RV1

findings.title: U4 harmonics in 30-88 MHz band
findings.description: U4 (AP63203WU-7) switching at 0.5 MHz has 117 harmonics in the 30-88 MHz band (harmonics 60-176). Envelope rolloff at 32 MHz (-40 dB/decade above).
findings.recommendation: Minimize switching loop area for U4. Place input cap as close as possible. Consider spread-spectrum modulation if available.
findings.summary: U4 harmonics in 30-88 MHz band

findings.title: U4 harmonics in 88-216 MHz band
findings.description: U4 (AP63203WU-7) switching at 0.5 MHz has 257 harmonics in the 88-216 MHz band (harmonics 176-432). Envelope rolloff at 32 MHz (-40 dB/decade above).
findings.recommendation: Minimize switching loop area for U4. Place input cap as close as possible. Consider spread-spectrum modulation if available.
findings.summary: U4 harmonics in 88-216 MHz band

findings.title: U4 harmonics in 216-960 MHz band
findings.description: U4 (AP63203WU-7) switching at 0.5 MHz has 1489 harmonics in the 216-960 MHz band (harmonics 432-1920). Envelope rolloff at 32 MHz (-40 dB/decade above).
findings.recommendation: Minimize switching loop area for U4. Place input cap as close as possible. Consider spread-spectrum modulation if available.
findings.summary: U4 harmonics in 216-960 MHz band

findings.title: U4 harmonic envelope
findings.description: U4 (AP63203WU-7) switching at 0.50 MHz, duty ≈50%. Harmonic envelope: flat to 0.3 MHz, -20 dB/dec to 32 MHz, -40 dB/dec above. Harmonics extend into FCC test range starting at 60th harmonic.
findings.recommendation: Minimize the hot loop area (input cap → high-side switch → inductor → low-side switch → input cap). Every halving of loop area reduces emissions by 6 dB.
findings.summary: U4 harmonic envelope
